artist.name: Pat Benatar
artist.profile: American singer born January 10, 1953, in Greenpoint, Brooklyn. Four-time Grammy Award winner. Married to songwriter [a=Neil Giraldo] since 1982, they have two daughters. Her artist's name "Benatar" comes from her first marriage to Dennis Benatar.
